_note: Wing-local dimensions (D1, revision D1-R1 on params A1-R3, 2026-11-09). Shared numbers (span, chord, section, spar, elevon spans, hinge, pod station, fin and block positions) come from redesign/params/params.json, subsystems/fins/params.json (block, anchor, bond gap), subsystems/pod/params.json (saddle feet, tie) and subsystems/harness/params.json (grooves); this file holds only what the wing designer chooses. Read by subsystems/wing/fusion/wing.py, team/D1/wing_data.py and team/D1/wing_claims.py. Metres unless stated.

bond_gap_m.note: radial bond line: slot / bore 22.4 mm on the 22 mm spar, epoxy + glass microballoons 1:1 by volume

fill_g.note: thickened epoxy in the slot and the cap glue line, booked in the core (WNG-001); weigh the mixed batch

slot_wall_m.note: foam left between the pod recess aft end and the spar (recess ends at x_spar - r_spar - 0.004 = 0.065); floor z = params pod.z_base_m, y = +/- pod width / 2; recess front = where the upper skin reaches the floor

tie_channel_m.note: width along y x radial depth of the channel round the spar at each pod tie, so the 7.6 x 1.3 mm nylon tie passes under the spar in a 22.4 mm bore; tie laid in before the spar bond. y range of the open window and the tie station come from subsystems/pod/params.json foot_y_m, tie_y_m, tongue_cheek_frac

gap_m.note: per side along y round D3's 16 mm anchor (fins anchor.len_y_m); along x the pocket is the full 22.4 mm slot width so the 20 mm saddle sits on the spar with thickened epoxy filling 1.2 mm each side (E-FIN-57...60)

x_m.source: subsystems/mechanisms (D6-R1) MEC-008 frame x 0.1724-0.2073 + 0.2 mm bond line
x_m.note: open on the LOWER skin (D6: servo laid on its side, case base flush with the lower skin, pushrod and horns below); aft of x 0.12 (C2 CR-C2-01); team/D1/wing_selfcheck.py compares it with the built MEC-008

y_m.note: outboard of the transport cradle patch (0.23) and 2.2 mm clear of the brace-anchor pocket (0.2505); 15 mm inboard of the half-fin root fillet; the arm plane y 0.285 is inside it

ceiling_z_m.source: subsystems/mechanisms (D6-R1) MEC-008 top plate z 0.0073 + 0.2 mm
ceiling_z_m.note: flat pocket ceiling; leaves >= 3.9 mm foam + upper skin over it at the aft wall

lead_hole_x_m.source: D1 choice (F2 CR-F2-04 servo groove, D6 lower pocket)
lead_hole_x_m.note: 4 mm square pass (drill 5 mm) from the end of the upper servo-lead branch groove down into the pocket front, at y = the branch (0.283-0.287); straw liner

doubler_w_m.note: chordwise tape band over the pocket edges, lower surface x 0.12 ... hinge, opening cut out (the cover is taped over it)

y_m.note: three ESC-lead grooves each surface, each side; x stations and sizes from subsystems/harness/params.json#harness.groove, #harness.groove_size_mm

servo_y_m.note: servo-lead groove on the upper surface aft of the spar slot (x from harness.groove.x_servo_m), then a branch along x at y 0.285 to the lead hole (servo_pocket.lead_hole_x_m) down into the lower pocket

end_gap_m.note: each panel end to the core cut-out (hot-wire kerf ~1 mm); fin-face and tip gaps are the params elevon spans (>= 15 mm)

bevel_deg.note: lower-edge bevel of the panel front face, measured from the vertical through the upper-skin hinge line: clears the core at +25 deg down with 1.07 mm; D6 uses it as the TE-down mechanical stop at about 28-30 deg

tube_groove_gap_m.note: routed groove for D6's CF 5 x 4 torque tube (position and size from subsystems/mechanisms/params.json#mec.tube), open on the lower face, full panel length, 0.2 mm bond line round the tube, filled with epoxy + microballoons

horn_slot_m.source: subsystems/mechanisms/params.json#mec.horn.plate_t_m (2.4 mm) + 0.1 mm; D6 'slot cut 2.5 mm through the panel'
horn_slot_m.note: through-panel slot for the horn blade at the arm plane (inboard panel) and the link-horn plane (outboard panel); x from the torque-tube groove front to the blade end (mec.horn.blade_x_mm)

model_t_m.note: CAD thickness of the tape bodies (one layer ~0.05 mm + overlap); mass comes from the surface arc length x params wing.skin.areal_mass_kgm2, not the CAD volume

untaped_upper_x_m.note: no tape on the upper surface under the pod (|y| <= pod width / 2): pod bonds to bare sanded foam (CR-C2-07)

block_doubler_x_m.note: 60 mm band (servo_pocket.doubler_w_m) wrapped round the LE from upper x 0.12 to lower x 0.12 over each through-core block pocket; slit round the tube and the half-fin roots

tip_extra_layers.note: one 48 mm strip folded round the tip edge over the normal skin = 2 layers at the tip (damage fuse, CR-C2-01)

x_m.note: upper surface, right wing, aft of the spar and ahead of the hinge: visible without tools (14 CFR 48.205), clear of the transport pillar (y 0.17-0.23), the servo doubler and the CG-jig patch (lower surface, |y| 0.45)

mass_g.note: printed vinyl label 100 x 30 mm, laminated; weigh

od_m.note: inside the 20 mm spar bore, bonded with thickened epoxy

block_len_m.note: under the through-core block spar bore, centred on |y| fins.y_m

anchor_len_m.note: under the brace anchors; upper and lower anchors share one plug per side

cost_usd.note: per wing; I1 owns the BOM prices
